name: top-navigation
title: Top Navigation
description: The app's top bar: an empty logo slot, section links with the current one in lime and optional New badges, a search pill with a ⌘K hint, a pricing link with a sale tag, an Assets button, the credit balance and the account control. Folds into a menu sheet when narrower than 1024px.

meta.use_when: You need the bar across the top of every page of a signed-in creative app, for moving between sections, searching, reaching pricing and assets, seeing credits and opening the account menu
